cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 219, from New York to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 219，从纽约飞往武汉，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 9200 米，因穿越冲突航空器，通过 9800 米前加快下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 9200 米，通过 9800 米前加快下降，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, you are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, inform ATC this situation and request further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 9200 米，遭遇中度晴空颠簸，告知 ATC 并请求继续下降至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 9200 meters, we are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，保持 9200 米，我们遭遇中度晴空颠簸，请求继续下降至 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，向武汉管制确认是否为冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动航空器，请确认是否为冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, negative, the aircraft is a military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，不是，该机为军机，与你当前航迹平行飞行，将很快超越你，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report clear of traffic, UAL 219.

cards.audioText: B: Now that aircraft has passed you, report it to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在该机已超过你，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, clear of traffic.

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计 ZF-03 进场跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36R, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计 ZF-03 进场跑道 36R，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 4200 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: You are now levelling at 4200 meters and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在 4200 米改平并接近 ZF，已收到通播 A，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 219, maintaining 4200 meters, approaching ZF, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 219，保持 4200 米，接近 ZF，收到通播 A。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, established ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: All stations! All stations! Be advised Runway 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, Break, UAL 219, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：各机注意！各机注意！跑道 36 右因故障航空器占用关闭。Break，Break，UAL 219，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are inbound course for Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 向台航道上，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，跑道 04 向台。
